title: OCPP Configuration
description: Configure your OCPP Central System (CSMS) for EV charging station management

host.title: Listen Host
host.description: Host address for the CSMS WebSocket server

port.title: Listen Port
port.description: Port for the CSMS WebSocket server

device_map_file.title: Device Map File
device_map_file.description: Path to JSON device map file for custom charge point variable mapping (optional)

charger_aliases_file.title: Charger Aliases File
charger_aliases_file.description: Path to JSON file mapping raw OCPP charge-point IDs to friendly trace paths (optional). Example: {"AABBCCDDEEFF": "depot_north/bay_3"}. Aliases may include '/' for hierarchical fleet grouping.

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often to request TriggerMessage for meter values from charge points

ssl_cert_file.title: TLS Certificate File
ssl_cert_file.description: Path to PEM certificate file for WSS/TLS (optional)

ssl_key_file.title: TLS Key File
ssl_key_file.description: Path to PEM private key file for WSS/TLS (optional)
